com.seuic.uhf

Class UHFService

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.seuic.uhf.UHFService
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    IUHFDevice

    public class UHFService
extends java.lang.Object
implements IUHFDevice
    UHFService class。

    The UHFService class provides methods for managing RFID readers and writers. It is implemented as a Singleton pattern. Calling getInstance(Context context) returns the object. Through this object, you can connect to the reader, configure the reader, operate the tag, etc.

      • killTagEx

        public boolean killTagEx(int filterbank,
                         int filteroffset,
                         int filterlen,
                         byte[] filterdata,
                         byte[] password)
        Kill tag extension

        Kills a specified tag data. The difference from the function killTag is that this function can specify filtering EPC, TID, User, The function killTag must specify the filter EPC. Kills a specified tag. The killed tag cannot be restored. Please use with caution. Before killing the tag, you must set a non-zero destruction password

        Specified by:
        killTagEx in interface IUHFDevice

        filteroffset, - Specifies the offset address of the filter tag, in bytes
        filterlen, - Specifies the data length of the filter tag, in bytes
        filterdata, - Specify the data for the filter tag
        password, - Kill password, 4 bytes
        Returns:
        true false
